purpose: Five alternative icon concepts for review; existing extension icons unchanged.

concepts.name: 01-cross-grid
concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: concept for Better X Likes, an independent Chrome extension that turns X timelines into responsive multi-column tweet grids, with nostalgia for the classic TweetDeck. Generate ONE polished square app icon, straight-on, occupying most of a 1024x1024 canvas. Flat vector-like graphic, crisp clean edges, generous simple forms readable at 32px. No wording, letters except the abstract X implied by geometry, no captions, no labels, no mockup, no device, no extra icons. Rounded square deep near-black navy tile, crisp high contrast. A distinct independent mark, not the stock X logo or official Twitter bird. Main palette classic Twitter/TweetDeck cyan blue, white, deep navy; small mint accents allowed. Maintain generous safe padding. Concept 1 CROSS GRID: A large bold unmistakable X-shaped mark formed by FOUR separated cyan-blue and white trapezoidal tweet-card tiles arranged in a two by two grid. A narrow dark vertical and horizontal gutter divides the four tiles. Each tile is geometrically cut so together their OUTER silhouette clearly reads as an X, while the two by two grouping remains instantly apparent. The four chunks form one cohesive monogram, not an ordinary four-square icon. Sharp diagonals, lightly softened corners; two opposite chunks blue, two white. Pure flat no shading.
